meta.age_note: Advantage+ lets the hard age minimum go no higher than 25. To enforce 30+, switch to original audience (Advantage+ off) or use 25 as control + age suggestion. Default: control 25, suggestion = segment age range; review age breakdown weekly and move to original audience if >20% of spend goes below segment age_min.
meta.income: No reliable US household-income targeting; the ZIP list is the income filter.
meta.special_ad_category: None for home services. Declare Financial Products only if the ad is about a loan or credit offer itself.

google_search.location: zip_list_or_radius, presence only (people in or regularly in)
google_search.demographics_mode: observation first; bid adjustments after 30 conversions
google_search.income_note: Top 50% starts near the US median household income ($83,730 in 2024). A $70K floor sits inside 'Lower 50%', so never exclude Lower 50% or Unknown on Search; use bid adjustments.
google_search.detailed_demographics: Homeowners (observe or target); exclude Renters only where segment allows

platform_rules.google_lsa: No demographic targeting: service area (ZIPs) and job types only. ZIP scoring decides the service-area list.
platform_rules.pmax_demand_gen: Audience signals: customer list, website visitors, Homeowners detailed demographic, in-market home services segments.

never_use: race, ethnicity, religion or other protected traits

segments.name: Replacement prospects
segments.zip_income: median >= $70K: cash offer; $50-70K: financing-first; under $50K: skip prospecting
segments.zip_filters: owner-occupied >= 60%; median year built <= 2005; single-family detached share high
segments.meta: Advantage+ on; control age 25, suggestion 35-65+; interests as suggestions: home improvement, roofing, home insurance
segments.google: Search: replacement keywords; observe Homeowners, age 35+, HHI tiers; exclude Renters

segments.name: Storm-hit ZIPs
segments.zip_filters: ZIPs with hail >= 1 in. or wind >= 60 mph in last 7 days
segments.meta: Advantage+ on; geo = affected ZIPs only; control age 25
segments.google: Search + LSA: storm/leak repair terms in affected ZIPs; no demographic exclusions

segments.name: Flat-roof / rowhome
segments.zip_filters: rowhome / attached housing share high; owner-occupied >= 50%
segments.meta: separate ad set and creative; same controls
segments.google: separate ad group: flat roof, rubber roof, roof coating

segments.name: No heat / no AC
segments.homeowner: preferred, not required (landlords and renters call too)
segments.google: Search + LSA: repair terms; no demographic exclusions; run nights/weekends only if phones answered

segments.name: System replacement
segments.google: Search: replacement/heat pump terms; observe Homeowners, age; exclude Renters
segments.seed: past repair customers with equipment 12+ yrs old

segments.name: Tune-up and membership
segments.zip_filters: past customers first; then high-score ZIPs
segments.meta: custom audience of past customers + lookalike
segments.google: Customer Match; Demand Gen to past customers

segments.name: Leak / clog / no hot water
segments.google: LSA + Search carry 85% of budget; no demographic exclusions

segments.name: Water heater replacement
segments.zip_filters: median year built 8-15+ yrs ago; owner-occupied >= 60%
segments.google: Search: water heater terms; observe Homeowners
segments.seed: customers with water heater install date 8+ yrs ago

segments.name: Repipe / sewer line
segments.google: Search: repipe, sewer camera, sewer line replacement

segments.name: Landlords / property managers
segments.google: Search: commercial plumber, property management plumbing

segments.name: Outage / safety emergency
segments.google: Search + LSA: emergency electrician terms

segments.name: Panel / service upgrade
segments.google: Search: panel upgrade, 200 amp; observe Homeowners
segments.seed: past service-call customers in older homes

segments.name: Standby generator
segments.zip_income: median >= $100K or median home value top third of service area
segments.google: Search: whole home generator; HHI bid +, observe Top 30%

segments.name: EV charger + panel
segments.google: Search: EV charger installation; in-market EV segments

segments.name: Exterior repaint
segments.zip_filters: owner-occupied >= 65%; wood/older siding; median home value above area median
segments.google: Search: house painters, exterior painting; observe Homeowners; exclude Renters

segments.name: Interior / cabinets
segments.google: Search: interior painting, cabinet painting

segments.name: HOAs / property managers
segments.google: Search: HOA painting, commercial painting

segments.name: Bill savings (lease/PPA or financed)
segments.zip_filters: high utility rates; net metering available; roof age under 15 yrs or bundle re-roof; low tree cover
segments.meta: Advantage+ on; suggestion 35-65; qualifying lead form (owner, utility, bill, roof age)
segments.google: Search: solar panels [city], solar lease; observe Homeowners; exclude Renters

segments.name: Battery / backup
segments.google: Search: solar battery, home battery backup

segments.name: Recurring maintenance
segments.zip_filters: larger lots; route clustering near current customers
segments.meta: Advantage+ on; suggestion 40-65+; geo = route ZIPs
segments.google: Search: lawn maintenance, lawn care service; observe Homeowners

segments.name: Spring / fall cleanup
segments.google: Search: spring cleanup, leaf removal

segments.name: Hardscape / design
segments.zip_income: median >= $120K or home value top third
segments.google: Search: patio installation, landscape design

segments.name: Snow removal (north)
segments.zip_filters: snowfall days; current maintenance customers first
segments.google: Search: snow removal [city]
